title: The Wild Horses
text: A herd of wild horses thunders across the plain, sleek and fast, manes streaming, the earth shaking under them. They wheel and stop to watch you, nostrils flaring.

options.label: The fastest tries to catch one for the House stables.

outcomes.text: They bring a fine horse home to the House stables.
They take a hoof to the ribs.

options.label: Watch them run, and let them be free.

outcomes.text: It is a good thing to have seen out here.

options.label: The gentlest lures one with food to earn its trust.

outcomes.text: It follows you a while, then all the way home.
